items.prompt: At equal final values, which claim is proved?

options.why: The proof only needs an optimum that pairs the equal final values; other optimal alignments may exist.
Repeated values are allowed; the exchange argument does not assume unique identifiers.
An exchange can produce an optimum pairing the equal final values, which supports diagonal plus one.
Matching the final values does not imply that the entire sequences are equal.

items.explanation: Final occurrence exchange preserves some optimum.
